# Day 3 — Calculus

Day 3 — Calculus / Exploration. Math covers limits, differentiation
and optimization (first-order conditions), and integration basics.
Programming continues exploring R's data structures (factors, data
frames), conditionals, and descriptive statistics.

This session has two parts:

- **[Math Session](slides.qmd)** — the in-class slideshow.
- **[Programming Session](programming.qmd)** — a webpage walking through the
  same material with runnable R code.
